about.feedback: Send feedback or report a problem
about.feedback_detail: Opens the issues page of the project on GitHub. Nothing from your library is added.
about.licence: Free software under the GNU GPL 3.0, with an exception that allows linking with OpenSSL.
about.what: A player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats.

chatfirst.chat_not_available: This chat is not available any more. You may have left it, or it was deleted.
chatfirst.chat_offline: Not connected. Tracks already in your library show here; the rest load once Telegram connects.
chatfirst.chat_removed: This chat is no longer in your library.
chatfirst.chat_waiting: Telegram asked us to wait {seconds} s. The list goes on by itself.
chatfirst.chats_empty: No chats yet. Add the chats that hold your music.
chatfirst.held_for_wifi: {count, plural, one {# track waits for Wi-Fi to have its details read} other {# tracks wait for Wi-Fi to have their details read}}
chatfirst.mobile_body: Track details such as albums and covers come from the start of each file. On Wi-Fi they are read in the background. On mobile data that can use a lot of data for a big library. The tracks you open or play get their details either way. You can change this in Settings.
chatfirst.mobile_title: Read track details on mobile data too?
chatfirst.not_finding_body: Only the chats you picked are read. Audio sent as files is found by the scan. Voice messages are skipped, and so are files Telegram restricts. Short clips and voice recordings are hidden unless you turn them on above.
chatfirst.picker_start_counting: Looking for the chats with the most audio…
chatfirst.picker_start_detail: Picks Saved Messages and up to 4 of your chats with the most audio. You can add more chats any time.
chatfirst.picker_start_none: No audio found in Saved Messages or your recent chats. Pick chats below.
chatfirst.settings_mobile: Read track details on mobile data
chatfirst.settings_mobile_detail: Off: track details are read in the background on Wi-Fi only. The tracks you open or play get theirs on any connection.
chatfirst.settings_short_detail: Clips under 30 seconds. A track whose length is not known yet is always shown.
chatfirst.settings_voice_detail: Recordings sent as files, such as voice memos. Voice messages are never in the library.

errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Start over to have a new one sent.
errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.flood_wait: Telegram has asked us to slow down. Try again in about {wait}.
errors.no_account: This number has no Telegram account yet. Create one in the Telegram app, then sign in here.
errors.no_answer: Telegram didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_api_credentials: No Telegram API credentials in this build. Add TG_API_ID and TG_API_HASH to local.properties and rebuild.
errors.no_space: This device has run out of storage. Free up some space, then try again.
errors.offline: Can't reach Telegram. Check this device's internet connection.
errors.phone_invalid: That number isn't one Telegram recognises. Include the country code, as in +44.
errors.premium_sign_in: Telegram won't send this number a code here. Sign in with a QR code from the Telegram app instead: start over, then choose Scan a QR code.
errors.signed_out: Telegram signed this device out. Sign in again to carry on.
errors.tdlib_unavailable: TDLib, the part of TMPlayer Music that talks to Telegram, could not start on this device. Please report this with the message: {message}
errors.unsupported_sign_in_step: This account needs a step TMPlayer Music can't do. Finish signing in in the Telegram app first, then try again.

home.speed_dial_gone: That track is no longer in its chat, so it was taken off Speed dial.

library.counts: {songs, plural, one {# song} other {# songs}} ({files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})
library.empty: No songs yet. Add chats with music in Manage chats, or wait for the scan to find them.
library.favourites_capped: {count, plural, one {Showing the latest # favourite.} other {Showing the latest # favourites.}}
library.favourites_empty: No favourites yet. Hold a song, then Add to favourites.

login.choose_body: Play the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Sign in to pick the chats with your music.
login.code_body_app: Telegram sent the code to the Telegram app on your other device.
login.phone_body: Include the country code, as in +44 7700 900123.
login.qr_body: On your phone, open Telegram, go to Settings, then Devices, then Link Desktop Device, and scan this code.
login.stalled: This is taking longer than usual. Check the connection, then try again.

logs.crash_body: Send the logs, so the problem can be fixed? You pick the app they go to. Chat names, numbers and file names are taken out first, and nothing is sent unless you choose to.
logs.failed: The logs could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
logs.no_app: No app on this phone can take the logs.
logs.send_detail: Recent app logs in a text file, for a bug report. Chat names, numbers, file names and secrets are taken out first. You pick the app they go to; nothing is sent by itself.

lyrics.ask_body: To find lyrics and missing covers, TMPlayer Music sends the title, artist and album of the song (and its length, for lyrics) to our lookup service, which asks LRCLIB for lyrics and MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive for covers. We keep nothing. Chat names and file names are never sent. You can turn this off in Settings, Lyrics.
lyrics.busy: Lyrics are busy. Try again in a minute.
lyrics.clear_detail: Lyrics found online are kept on this device only, so a song is looked up once. Clearing them is safe.
lyrics.covers_clear_detail: Covers found online are kept on this device only, up to 200 MB, so an album is looked up once. Clearing them is safe.
lyrics.need_length: Looking up lyrics needs the track's length, and this file doesn't say how long it is.
lyrics.none: No lyrics for this track. A .lrc file with the same name in the same chat, or lyrics in the file's tags, show here.
lyrics.not_found: No lyrics found for this track.
lyrics.online_detail: When a track has no lyrics or cover in its file or chat, its title, artist and album (and its length, for lyrics) go to our lookup service, which asks LRCLIB, MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive. Covers download on Wi-Fi, or on mobile data if you allowed it for track details. Chat names, file names and your account are never sent.
lyrics.online_title: Look up lyrics and covers online
lyrics.title: Lyrics

manage.body: These chats are read for audio. Removing one takes its tracks out of the library; your messages in Telegram are not touched.
manage.remove_body: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing from this chat is in your library yet.} one {# track leaves your library.} other {# tracks leave your library.}} Your messages in Telegram are not touched.
manage.scanning: {count, plural, one {Scanning, # track so far} other {Scanning, # tracks so far}}
manage.title: Manage chats

menu.favourites_full: You have 20,000 favourites, the most there can be.

nowplaying.clear_queue_body: {count, plural, one {# track leaves the queue.} other {# tracks leave the queue.}} Your library and playlists are not touched.

picker.body: Tick the chats that hold your music. You can add or remove chats later in Manage chats.
picker.confirm_all_body: Scanning many chats takes longer and uses more data. You can remove chats later.
picker.count: {count, plural, one {# audio file} other {# audio files}}
picker.empty: No chats yet. Chats you join in Telegram show up here.
picker.no_audio: No audio messages. Files sent as documents are found by the scan.
picker.title: Pick the chats with music
picker.total: {chats, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}, {files, plural, =0 {counting files} one {about # file} other {about # files}}

player.unknown_length: The length of this track is not known, so it can't be seeked.

playlist.delete_body: The playlist goes; the songs stay in your library.
playlist.empty: No songs yet. Add songs from their menu: hold a song, then Add to playlist.
playlist.full: This playlist is full: a playlist holds at most 10,000 songs.
playlist.name: Name
playlist.too_many: You have 1,000 playlists, the most there can be. Delete one to make another.

scan.failed_chats: {count, plural, one {# chat could not be read} other {# chats could not be read}}
scan.failed_chats_sub: Tap to see why and try again.
scan.hide_label: Hide the reading progress. Turn it back on in Settings, Library.
scan.keep_listening: You can keep listening while this runs.
scan.offline_sub: Reading carries on by itself once you are online.
scan.paused_progress: Paused, track details read for {done} of {total}
scan.paused_sub: Background reading is paused; what is on screen still loads. Tap Resume to carry on.
scan.running: Scanning {current} of {total} chats, {found, plural, one {# track so far} other {# tracks so far}}
scan.waiting: Telegram asked us to wait {seconds} s before reading more

settings.details_failed: {count, plural, one {# file couldn't be read} other {# files couldn't be read}}
settings.free_up_body: Your songs stay in the library and stream again when you play them. Nothing in Telegram is touched.
settings.free_up_failed: Couldn't free up space. Try again in a moment.
settings.haptics_detail: A light tap or tick under your finger for play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, the seek bar and the queue. The phone's own touch feedback setting still applies.
settings.last_checked_now: Checked for new tracks just now
settings.last_never: Not checked for new tracks yet
settings.library_counts: {tracks, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} from {chats, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}
settings.limit_note: The cache never takes more than a share of this device's storage: at most {size} here.
settings.show_progress_detail: The banner while chats are scanned and track details are read. This section always shows the progress, and a chat that could not be read is shown either way.
settings.state_scanning: Looking for tracks in your chats
settings.test_versions_off: Off: only full releases are offered
settings.test_versions_on: The test version that comes before each release is offered too
settings.title: Settings
settings.update_check_on_open: Check for updates when the app opens
settings.update_check_on_open_detail: Asks GitHub at most every six hours, only while the app is open. Nothing is downloaded or installed without you.

shell.log_out_body: The library on this phone is cleared, playlists and favourites included. Nothing in your Telegram chats changes.

signin.country_no_match: Nothing matches that. Try the country's name in English, or its dial code.
signin.delivery_app: We sent a code to the Telegram app on your other device. Check Telegram, not your texts.
signin.delivery_call: You are about to get a call to {number} reading out the code.
signin.delivery_firebase: We are checking this device with Google, then texting a code to {number}.
signin.delivery_flash_call: Telegram is calling {number}. You do not have to answer: the number that calls is the code.
signin.delivery_fragment: Your code is waiting for you on Fragment.
signin.delivery_missed_call: You are about to get a call you do not have to answer. The code is the last digits of the number that calls.
signin.delivery_phrase: We texted you a phrase. Type the phrase, not a number.
signin.delivery_unknown: Telegram has sent a code to {number}.
signin.delivery_word: We texted you a word. Type the word, not a number.
signin.error_code_unavailable: Telegram can't send the code another way. Use the one you have, or start over.
signin.error_phone_banned: Telegram has blocked this number, so it can't sign in. Telegram's support can say why.
signin.invalid_country_code: No country has this code. Check it, or choose your country from the list.
signin.no_country: Choose your country, or type its dial code.
signin.number_too_short: That number is too short. Check it, area code included.
signin.password_blurb: Your Telegram account has a password. Enter it to finish signing in.
signin.phone_blurb: Telegram will send a code to the account this number belongs to.
signin.qr_expires_soon: A new code is on its way
signin.qr_note: The code refreshes on its own. It is read by Telegram and nobody else.
signin.qr_step_link: Tap Link Desktop Device and point the camera here
signin.qr_stuck: New codes are not coming through. Check your connection, then try again.
signin.resend_app: Send to the Telegram app instead
signin.slow: Still waiting for Telegram. This can take a while on a slow connection.

sleep.end_of_track: At the end of this track
sleep.title: Sleep timer

storage.not_enough: Not enough space to play this track: it needs {needed} and {free} is free. Free up space in Settings, or make room on the device.

support.ask_text: You have played {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} to the end here. TMPlayer Music has no ads of its own and no account of ours. If it earns a spot in your day, a coffee keeps it going. It is voluntary and unlocks nothing.
support.channel_detail: Rare notes from the app, such as the sponsor reminder
support.note: Voluntary. It unlocks nothing: every feature is free for everyone.
support.notify_sponsor_body: If TMPlayer Music is useful to you, a coffee keeps it going. It stays free, with every feature, either way.
support.notify_sponsor_title: Don't forget to sponsor TMPlayer Music
support.notify_star_body: A star on GitHub costs nothing and helps more people find it.
support.reminders_detail: Now and then, never more than once a month, a notification asking whether TMPlayer Music has earned a coffee
support.title: Support TMPlayer Music

update.blocked_phone: This phone blocks installs from TMPlayer Music. Allow them in the setting this opens, then come back here.
update.conflict: This update is signed with a different key from the TMPlayer Music you have, so Android will not install it over this one. Download it from {page} instead.
update.could_not_save: Could not save the download. Try again in a moment.
update.damaged: The download was damaged and was not installed.
update.downloading: Downloading {size} from GitHub. You can close this window; Cancel stops it and keeps what has arrived.
update.github_answered: GitHub answered {code}. Try again in a moment.
update.incompatible: This update does not run on this phone: its Android version or its processor is not supported.
update.install_failed: Android did not install the update: {reason}. The version you have is unchanged.
update.installing_restart: Installing. TMPlayer Music closes for a moment and says when it is updated.
update.needs_space: The update needs {needed} free and this phone has {free}. Free up some space and try again.
update.newest: You are on {version}, the newest release on {page}.
update.no_apk: The newest release has no APK to install.
update.no_installer: Android could not open the installer. Install it by hand from the release page.
update.no_version: GitHub sent a release with no version on it.
update.not_newer: The download is not newer than the version you have, so it was not installed.
update.not_this_app: The download is not an update of this TMPlayer Music, so it was not installed.
update.offline: Connect to the internet to check for updates.
update.rate_limited: GitHub has had too many requests from this connection. Try again in an hour.
update.resumes: {done} of {size} is already downloaded, so Update now goes on from there.
update.size_and_confirm: The update is {size} from GitHub. Android asks you to confirm before it installs.
update.size_and_restart: The update is {size} from GitHub. It installs without asking, and TMPlayer Music closes for a moment.
update.title: TMPlayer Music {version} is out
update.title_skipped: TMPlayer Music {version} is out (you skipped it)
update.unreachable: Could not reach GitHub. Try again in a moment.
update.up_to_date: TMPlayer Music is up to date

versions.tap_to_play: Tap a version to play it.
versions.why_lossless: Plays the lossless version by default.
versions.why_oldest: These versions are alike, so the first one posted plays by default.
versions.why_on_device: Plays the version already on this device by default.
versions.why_playable: Plays the version this app can play by default.
versions.why_preferred: Plays the version you chose by default.
versions.why_quality: Plays the version with the higher quality by default.
versions.why_smaller: Plays the smaller version by default to save mobile data.
versions.why_tags: Plays the version with the fuller details by default.

welcome.body: A player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. You choose which chats it reads; nothing else is touched.
